description:

The University of South Wales has campuses in Cardiff, Newport and Pontypridd. It was formed in 2013 after the merger of the University of Glamorgan and the University of Wales. This made it the second largest university in Wales with over 23,000 students studying across around 200 undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

It welcomes around 3,000 international students each year from 124 countries. Its three faculties are Computing, Engineering & Science; Business & Creative Industries; and Life Sciences & Education. It also has a film school, animation facilities and a reputation for theatre design.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value:
The University of South Wales (USW) was formed in 2013 after the merger of the University of Glamorgan and the University of Wales. This makes it the second largest university in Wales, with over 23,000 students studying across 200 undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

Its three faculties are Computing, Engineering & Science, Business & Creative Industries, and Life Sciences & Education. It also has a film school, animation facilities and a reputation for theatre design.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value:
Your student life at USW will be inclusive and supportive. The Students’ Union hosts a rich mix of clubs and societies. The university welcomes around 3,000 international students each year from 124 countries. It offers you cost-of-living support in the form of advice, rental schemes and more. You can also gain access to free tickets to festivals and theatre productions, equipment loans, free laptops and PCs.  

A diverse range of people, interests and faiths are represented on campus, with student clubs including the Bangladesh Society, Christian Union and e-sports. In fact, USW has a student satisfaction rate of 81% according to the National Student Survey 2021.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
USW offers a range of modern and comfortable accommodation options on campus. You can choose from various types of university-managed residence halls. The student support staff are there to help you through the entire process. Each of the university’s campuses has halls of residence available for student use. All rooms are fully furnished.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
USW offers you several study spaces and extensive library resources across all campuses, with online and physical materials to support learning.

Sports
You’ll find many sports facilities spread across the three campuses of the university. The state-of-the-art facility located in Treforest is one of the premier sports training centres in Wales. It offers a full-sized 3G pitch for football and rugby, an indoor sports hall with multiple court options for basketball and badminton, and many more.

Laboratory
You’ll also find multiple lab facilities, including specialised engineering laboratories, health and medical labs, computing labs, and many more.

Cafeteria
You can dine at multiple cafes across USW campuses, including the Atrium Cafe and the Hub Cafe.
